lesson_title: Build text and speech solution patterns in Foundry
learner_starting_state: Can distinguish text-analysis and speech workloads and trace endpoint, credential, request, and response boundaries.
learner_ending_state: Can choose and trace a safe Foundry text or speech solution pattern, including input/output direction, client configuration, result handling, and action boundaries.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer forms across six text-and-speech solution boundaries, then explain one complete pattern and its action safeguard without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 scope and current Foundry, Language, Speech, and SDK claims cite official Microsoft sources.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify portal labels, SDK/API versions, endpoints, authentication, features, languages, voices, formats, regions, quotas, pricing, preview status, and deprecations before live use.

notes: Offline solution-pattern lab only; no text/audio is sent, no service is called, and no Azure or external action is authorized.
